source_id: BW-VMS-01 STT R1-R4: Pre-registered Approved Visit Full Lifecycle
purpose: Exercise full 4-step happy-path state progression from submission to completion
preconditions: Clean test database, unblacklisted visitor and valid host
action_or_input: Execute sequential lifecycle: (1) Submit pre-registration -> (2) Host approves -> (3) Guard checks in -> (4) Guard checks out

source_id: BW-VMS-01 Guard: Out-of-order check-out before check-in rejected
purpose: Verify out-of-order state transition attempting checkout without prior check-in fails
preconditions: VisitRequest is APPROVED and VisitorPass is ACTIVE, but visitor has never checked in (no active session)
